DTO.name: ForcePacketDTO
DTO.MATH: 12 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 8 = 32 bytes. All 4-byte fields are 4-byte aligned; _pad0 is 8-byte aligned at offset 24.
DTO.FALSE_SHARING: Not an atomic counter and not independently written by multiple workers to adjacent contested scalar fields. Each job index writes one row; row stride is explicitly 32 bytes for transport density.

DTO.name: AbyssalCavitationTuningDTO
DTO.MATH: Sixteen 4-byte lanes = 64 bytes. New tuner fields occupy prior padding; DTO size and BufferID identity do not change.

DTO.name: ShockwaveTelemetryEntry
DTO.note: 300-row black-box ring; affected entities and epsilon clamp counts at offsets 56 and 60.

DTO.name: AcousticDeafeningSignal
